summary: The focused orphan-comment cleanup claim does not require a harness update: the old harness creates a parser with flags set to zero, so its inputs cannot create a saved comment.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the fixed parser flags and all harness calls and exits.

claims.necessity_reason: The frozen condition requires parser->last_comment to hold a saved comment. Comment saving is guarded by UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS, while the fixed harness calls ucl_parser_new(0). Fuzzer input bytes cannot change that flag, so the condition is unreachable in this harness.

before.requirement: Release an orphan saved comment at the terminal state-machine cleanup point or during parser destruction.
before.reason: The before source has a terminal release path but no destructor release for last_comment. Neither path can receive an orphan saved comment from this zero-flag harness.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The comment-saving call is guarded by the save-comments flag.
Parser creation stores the supplied flags and creates comment storage only when the save-comments flag is set.

after.requirement: Release an orphan saved comment once at the terminal cleanup point or during parser destruction.
after.reason: The after source clears last_comment after terminal release and releases a remaining comment in the destructor. The fixed harness still cannot create a saved comment.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The comment-saving call remains guarded by the save-comments flag.
Parser creation retains the supplied zero flags and does not create comment storage.

claims.comparison_reason: Both changes concern ownership of saved comments. On both source versions, the same old harness passes zero flags and has no operation that enables comment saving, so the frozen orphan-comment condition never arises.
